samples.summary: New alignment validator has no positive test for a legitimate alignment value
samples.evidence: The delta adds `assertValidBlockStyle` with a closed `BLOCK_ALIGNMENTS` set. The two new tests in docs-content.controller.spec.ts cover (a) a hostile string being rejected and (b) `style: {}` (alignment absent) passing. Nothing asserts that a real alignment such as `'center'`/`'justify'` is accepted, so a regression that narrowed or emptied `BLOCK_ALIGNMENTS` (rejecting every legitimate PUT with a 400) would leave the suite green.
